faq_items.a: Open a doctor's profile, pick a date and a chamber session, and confirm. You get a serial number and an estimated arrival time (about 10 minutes per patient), so you only need to arrive around your turn.
No. Booking a serial is free — you pay the doctor's consultation fee at the chamber, as usual.
Yes. Go to My appointments and tap Cancel serial. Please cancel if you can't make it, so the chamber knows.

faq_items.q: How do I know a doctor is genuine?
faq_items.a: Each profile shows the doctor's BMDC registration number, so you can check it with the Bangladesh Medical & Dental Council.

faq_items.q: What should I do in an emergency?
faq_items.a: Cura is not an emergency service. Call 999 for an ambulance or urgent help, or 16263 (Shasthya Batayon) for free medical advice — both are available 24/7.
Not yet — this is a demo build. Doctors and hospitals are sample data and no real appointment is created, so please don't enter real medical details.
